lead: The scroll area of a conversation, stuck to the bottom: while you are at the bottom, new messages and streamed output scroll into view; when you scroll up to read history it leaves you alone and shows a back-to-bottom button. The root is `role=log`, so screen readers announce new messages.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: Put it in a parent with a height. Scroll up a little and the back-to-bottom button appears; click "Add a turn" and, at the bottom, it follows the new message.
usage.label: Demo conversation
usage.answer: Here is an answer for question {n}. It is a bit long so that the conversation needs to scroll: theme styles are plain CSS files, switched with a data attribute on the document, and behaviour comes from Base UI.

questions.q3: Can I switch theme styles at runtime?

streaming.title: Streaming
streaming.description: While a reply streams in, the thread keeps following it as long as you stay at the bottom; scroll up and it stops following.
streaming.label: Streaming conversation
streaming.empty: Press the button to stream a reply.
streaming.text: The reply is streaming in word by word and the thread keeps following it as long as you stay at the bottom. Scroll up to read earlier messages: it stops following and a button appears to jump back down.

api.title: API Reference
api.root: `ChatThread` is a `div` with `role=log`. Put it in a parent with a height: it fills it and scrolls inside; it can be focused with the keyboard.
api.scrollButton: The back-to-bottom button: it appears only when not at the bottom; clicking it scrolls down and sticks to the bottom again. `children` can replace the icon.
api.name: Name
api.content: The centered message column: limits the maximum width and spaces the messages
api.hook: Inside ChatThread, reads "is at the bottom" and "scroll to the bottom", for a custom back-to-bottom button

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.root: The scroll area; `data-at-bottom` means it is at the bottom now
styling.button: The back-to-bottom button's positioning layer: stuck to the bottom edge of the viewport, taking no height itself; it holds a Button
